limitations: A plugin source pin is not native, visual or security acceptance.
Hyprland 0.57 Lua/manager APIs are source-reviewed; native and fresh-VM acceptance remains outstanding.
hyprpm update and enable can reconcile live plugin load state and request sudo internally.
Header setup may overwrite /usr/share/pkgconfig/hyprland.pc; its previous state must be backed up.
The Ubuntu PPA backend currently links Lua 5.4; its process-scoped include workaround is retained.
Preparation refuses enabled plugins and unrelated manager repositories.
Startup reload requires separate backed-up plugin-login consent; no legacy plugin unload is authorized.
